{{italic title}}
'''''Fondements de la Géometrie Algébrique''''' ('''''FGA''''') is a book that collected together seminar notes of [[Alexander Grothendieck]]. It is an 
important source for his pioneering work on [[scheme theory]], which laid foundations for [[algebraic geometry]] in its modern technical developments. 
The title is a translation of the title of [[André Weil]]'s book ''[[Foundations of Algebraic Geometry]].''
It contained material on [[descent theory]], and existence theorems including that for the [[Hilbert scheme]]. The ''Technique de descente et théorèmes d'existence en géometrie algébrique'' is one series of seminars within ''FGA''.

Like the bulk of Grothendieck's work of the [[IHÉS]] period, duplicated notes were circulated, but the publication was not as a conventional book.

==Contents==
These are [[Séminaire Bourbaki]] notes, by number, from the years 1957 to 1962.
*[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1961-1962__7__297_0 Fondements de la géométrie algébrique. Commentaires] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 14, 1961/62, Complément];
*[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1956-1958__4__169_0 Théorème de dualité pour les faisceaux algébriques cohérents] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 9, 1956/57, no. 149]; ([[coherent duality]])
*[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1958-1960__5__193_0 Géométrie formelle et géométrie algébrique] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 11, 1958/59, no. 182]; ([[formal geometry]])
*Technique de descente et théorèmes d'existence en géométrie algébrique. I-VI
**[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1958-1960__5__299_0 I. Généralités. Descente par morphismes fidèlement plats] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 12, 1959/60, no. 190];
**[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1958-1960__5__369_0 II. Le théorème d'existence en théorie formelle des modules] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 12, 1959/60, no. 195];
**[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1960-1961__6__99_0 III. Préschémas quotients] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 13, 1960/61, no. 212];
**[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1960-1961__6__249_0 IV. Les schémas de Hilbert] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 13, 1960/61, no. 221];
**[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1961-1962__7__143_0 V. Les schémas de Picard. Théorèmes d'existence] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 14, 1961/62, no. 232];
**[http://www.numdam.org/item?id=SB_1961-1962__7__221_0 VI. Les schémas de Picard. Propriétés générales] [Séminaire Bourbaki, t. 14, 1961/62, no. 236]
